title: Private holdout manifest
description: Private corpus manifest for payable-receipt-ocr holdout evaluation.

corpus_version.description: Opaque holdout version identifier, e.g. holdout-v2026-08.

frozen_at.description: Timezone-qualified ISO-8601 freeze timestamp for this corpus version.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of canonicalized manifest JSON with this field removed.

runtime_baseline_id.description: Expected package runtime baseline identifier for conformant runs.

case_id.description: Opaque case identifier. Do not embed filenames or personal data.

image_relpath.description: Path relative to corpus root; evaluator rejects absolute and escaping paths.

app.description: Source app bucket used for stratification gates.

capture_type.description: Opaque capture category such as screenshot or camera.

expected_total.description: Positive canonical two-decimal label assigned before OCR evaluation.
